title: Tundrid Hills
wikitext:
[[Image:The Tundrid Hills.jpg|thumb|300px|The Tundrid Hills]]

'''The Tundrid Hills''' are located in the southcentral area of [[Dun Morogh]] and west of [[Gol'Bolar Quarry]]. The hills are home to several species of hostile wildlife, and few travel here without a weapon handy. Sometimes, adventurers use the Tundrid Hills as a shortcut to travel between [[Coldridge Valley]] and eastern Dun Morogh, although this is a significantly more dangerous route than following the road through [[Kharanos]].
